description: This class implements the DiagnosisDAO interface using Hibernate for database operations related to Diagnosis objects in the OpenMRS medical record system. It includes methods for saving, retrieving, and deleting diagnoses, as well as handling diagnosis attribute types and attributes.

classes.name: HibernateDiagnosisDAO
classes.description: Implementation of the DiagnosisDAO interface using Hibernate ORM for database operations related to diagnoses in OpenMRS.

methods.name: setSessionFactory
methods.description: Sets the Hibernate SessionFactory used for database interactions.

methods.name: saveDiagnosis
methods.description: Saves or updates a Diagnosis object in the database.

methods.name: getActiveDiagnoses
methods.description: Retrieves all active diagnoses for a specific patient, optionally filtered from a given date.

methods.name: getDiagnosesByEncounter
methods.description: Fetches diagnoses associated with a specific encounter, with options to filter by primary diagnosis and confirmation status.

methods.name: getDiagnosesByVisit
methods.description: Fetches diagnoses associated with a specific visit, with filtering options similar to getDiagnosesByEncounter.

methods.name: getDiagnosisById
methods.description: Retrieves a Diagnosis by its unique ID.

methods.name: getDiagnosisByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a Diagnosis by its UUID.

methods.name: deleteDiagnosis
methods.description: Deletes a Diagnosis object from the database.

methods.name: getDiagnosisAttributeTypeById
methods.description: Retrieves a DiagnosisAttributeType by its ID.

methods.name: deleteDiagnosisAttributeType
methods.description: Removes a DiagnosisAttributeType from the database.
